description: Create a payment link for a quote. The customer pays and enters the shipping address on the linked page. Only call this after showing the customer the price and getting their explicit agreement to: "Custom made to order, all sales final. I agree to the Terms (mandarin3d.com/terms, including section 6: cancellations, refunds and reprints)." Otherwise give them the order_url from quote_file instead.

customer_accepted_terms.description: True only if the customer explicitly agreed to the terms sentence above.

material.description: "pla" (default) or "petg". PETG is made to order in black or white: we order the filament after you buy, which adds 3 to 5 business days, and the print price is 20% higher. Other materials (TPU, ABS, ASA and more) on request: ask in the designer chat and we reply with a price.

colorNote.description: Which parts get which color (required with extraColors).

fileCheck.description: +$5. We review the file for printability and fit before printing and email you if something looks off.

rush.description: +50% of the print price. Printed within 1 business day. Ships with the same USPS service.
